pack:
## Who they are
LearnFresh (also written Learn Fresh) is a nonprofit that uses students' love of sports to teach math and STEM, focused on low-income communities. Flagship program: NBA Math Hoops. Other programs: MLB Players STEM League, MLS STEM Goals.

## People
- Lia Peralta Looram: Director of Marketing, day-to-day contact. Owns social, web, PR, email.
- Kaitlyn Woodward Patterson: Chief Development Officer.
- Nick Monzi: CEO and Co-Founder (spelled Monzi).
- Our lead: Nick Reis.
- Research partner: WestEd (one word). David McKinney (Senior Research Associate) and Kirk Walters ran the NBA Math Hoops RCT.
- Funder: Overdeck Family Foundation (Emma Banay, Senior Portfolio Manager).
- Partner: NBPA Foundation (Erika Swilley, Executive Director). Never "NBA Foundation".

## The moment
The NBA Math Hoops RCT (WestEd, Jackson, Mississippi, summer program) is the proof they waited ten years for: math and basketball is fun, and it works. Students moved from the 50th to the 58th percentile in 12 to 14 days of instruction; Learn Fresh says it as about four to five months of learning in 17 to 24 hours. Their end-of-year campaign "Make Every Hour Count" is built on that line.

## Rules for every cut
- The RCT is about NBA Math Hoops only. Never say the results are true for other Learn Fresh programs.
- NBA Math Hoops is a supplement to math class, never a replacement.
- Never criticise ed-tech or AI (their funders invest in it).
- Students on screen: first name + last initial + grade only. No school names on screen.
- Diversity on screen: girls as well as boys, across ethnicities.
- Kids reacting and excited beat kids concentrating quietly.
- Short cuts: one strong answer per subject, no RCT numbers (numbers belong in the documentary).
- Every cut ends on one of three calls to action (agreed with Lia, 2 Nov 2026): Read the full study (researchers, grantmakers: the WestEd interviews), Learn more at learnfresh.org (educators and partners: adults), Donate to Learn Fresh (general public: the students and the strongest testimonials). Never mention the end-of-year campaign or Giving Tuesday on screen, so the cuts stay evergreen.

## Brand
Font: RangleRiforma Bold. Logos: LearnFresh primary + NBA Math Hoops co-brand. Brand kit and style guide are in Airtable.
